lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately four distinct longitudinal rows that follow the curvature of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect across the lateral surface, with many circular blobs positioned at these grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and a shadow transition on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras); one is attached to the dorsal-lateral surface near the fifth gill slit, and at least three others are visible in the water column near the pectoral fin.
